## About

Ajaypal Singh (also known as Ajaypal Singh Solanki, Ajaypalsingh) is a founder, builder, and entrepreneur based in India. He is the founder of Ojaven, a platform for modern digital agencies currently in development with a planned launch date of 10 July 2027.

Ajaypal Singh works across the full lifecycle of software products — from raw idea and system design to implementation and operations. His approach to building software centers on durability, clean design, and deliberate problem-solving.

## Current Venture

- Name: Ojaven
- Description: A platform for modern agencies — simplifying workflows, client collaboration, and project execution for digital agencies.
- Status: In Development
- Planned Launch: 10 July 2027
- Founded by: Ajaypal Singh

## Core Principles

1. Substance Over Noise — Prioritize tangible product execution over performative networking.
2. Craftsmanship at Scale — Software should be fast, reliable, and deeply intuitive.
3. Patience & Compounding — Significant companies take years of consistent execution to build.
